question: Who has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the second woman officer from the medical branch of the Indian Air Force (IAF) to attain the esteemed rank of Air Marshal, in October 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Air Marshal Sadhna S Nair.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Air Marshal Sadhna S Nair became the **second woman officer** from the medical branch of the IAF to attain the rank of Air Marshal in October 2023.
 
• Before her promotion, she served as the Principal Medical Officer (PMO) at HQ Training Command, IAF.
 
• She is** now the Director General Hospital Services, Armed Forces (DGHS, AF).**
 
• The** first woman to achieve this rank** in the medical branch was **Air Marshal Padma Bandopadhyay.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Air Marshal Sadhna S Nair was** born on January 15, 1965.**
 
• She hails from **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.**
 
• **Shaliza Dhami:** She is known for being the** first woman officer to command a frontline combat unit** in the IAF.
 
• **Wing Commander Deepika Misra:** She is a notable helicopter pilot in the IAF and has been awarded the **Vayu Sena Medal.**
